About this offline walkthrough

Download this HTML file, then double-click it in a desktop browser. Everything needed for the interactive social-listening demo is embedded. No installation, server, credentials or internet connection is needed.

Using the walkthrough

Start with Guided, with explanations. Show me points to the next control. Fill example and field-level Use example enter editable simulated answers. Saving labels, granting consent, publishing and activating remain explicit actions.

With guidance on, Previous action revisits an instruction on the current screen; Return to current action resumes. Previous stage / Next stage move between screens while keeping drafts and saved work. Going back does not undo completed actions or reopen closed evidence rounds.

Guidance and annotations switch independently without resetting your work. The EyeTrustAI logo returns to the chooser after confirmation. Refresh, restart, choosing another experience or opening a checkpoint starts a new session. Configuration drafts and labels are not saved between sessions.

What this demonstration represents

EyeTrustAI configuration, the Relay workflow editor and the Signaldesk listening workspace form one fictional customer journey. Northstar Intelligence, Aster mentions, connections, scores and policy outcomes are simulated. This is not a live Talkwalker connection, actual certification or a partnership claim.

The mistake is automatically removing a priority post from immediate analyst review. This module's illustrated contract applies both limits: no more than 5% priority posts in the automatically deprioritized pool and no more than 1% of priority posts escaping immediate review. Neither means that every individual decision is correct.

The small practice-labeling set is separate from the explicitly loaded synthetic completed cohort. This file does not train a scorer or compute a scientific certificate from your practice labels.

Privacy and local files

No network requests, live queues, emails or support messages are sent. Keep all entries fictional. The optional JSON sample import reads only a file you explicitly choose, into this session. Download example saves the bundled synthetic JSON sample to your computer. No files are read automatically.

This file includes only the current social-listening walkthrough. Older versions and the separate clinical walkthrough are not bundled.
